title: Group Fitness Class Passes: the corporate wellness loyalty bonus added to a pack refund
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Group Fitness Class Passes product line. It states the loyalty bonus added to a pack's refund for a member who holds an active corporate wellness enrollment.

## Basis
A member who holds an active corporate wellness enrollment at the time of the refund receives a loyalty bonus added on top of the refund amount reached after the no-show deduction step. The bonus equals that refund amount multiplied by the lesser of two rates: the employer's own discount rate under the enrollment, and this tier's own corporate wellness discount rate. Whichever of the two rates is lower is the one applied; they are never added together. A member who does not hold an active corporate wellness enrollment at the time of the refund receives no such bonus at all.

## Condition table
| Active corporate wellness enrollment at time of refund? | Loyalty bonus |
|---|---|
| No | None |
| Yes | The refund amount after the no-show deduction, multiplied by the lower of the employer's rate and the tier's own rate |

## Hypothetical worked example (illustration only)
Suppose, purely for illustration, the refund amount after the no-show deduction were $50.00, the tier's own corporate wellness discount rate were 7 percent, and the member's employer offered 10 percent under its enrollment. Because 7 percent is the lower of the two, the loyalty bonus is $50.00 multiplied by 7 percent, added on top of the $50.00. Had the member held no active enrollment at the time of the refund, no bonus would be added at all.

## Points of judgement
- Enrollment activity is judged at the time of the refund, not at the time the pack was purchased or the credits were used.
- The bonus is calculated on the refund amount already net of the no-show deduction, not on any earlier, undeducted figure.
